assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original editorial website hero photograph for Rarewood Exchange, an independent specialty lumber brokerage.
Primary request: A thoughtfully arranged selection of rich hardwood boards and a striking live-edge slab in a quiet, well-lit timber workshop. This is conceptual illustrative scenery, not a depiction of actual supplier inventory.
Style/medium: Sophisticated architectural magazine photography, authentic tactile realism.
Composition/framing: Wide horizontal 3:2 photograph, generous immersive crop that shows the beauty of the boards and the live-edge slab, carefully composed without feeling staged.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural window light, quiet and inviting.
Color palette: Deep walnut and honey tones.
Materials/textures: Fine visible wood grain, natural edges, varied hardwood surfaces.
Avoid: People, branding, text, signs, logos, watermarks.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Original square standalone transparent decorative website illustration for Rarewood Exchange.
Primary request: Vintage agricultural/reference-book engraving of an elegant small arrangement of hardwood boards with visible grain and a live-edge slab cross-section.
Style/medium: Delicate fine pencil drawing and etched crosshatching, monochrome warm olive-gray #77755c strokes.
Composition/framing: Square canvas, airy centered composition occupying roughly 75% of the canvas, the complete arrangement visible with breathing room.
Scene/backdrop: Genuine fully transparent background, with transparent empty areas between the objects and behind the fine linework.
Avoid: Text, borders, paper, background color, heavy fills, cast shadows, logos, watermarks.
